sre.custom_item.hint.hold_orientation: Only affects first/third-person hold pose; inventory, dropped item, and item frames are unaffected
sre.custom_item.hint.invisible_in_hand: When enabled, other players cannot see this item while you hold it (like the Diviner's crystal ball or the Great Detective's notes); you can still see and use it normally; only affects appearance
sre.custom_item.hint.hold_tuning: Only affects first/third-person hand position. A flat 16×16 texture is centered on the hand, so the bottom edge of the texture is not the hand; combined with the tilt of the 'vertical' pose, the texture's own 'down' is 55° downward in third person, so drawing the gun handle to the bottom row still floats outside the hand. X/Y/Z are the texture's own coordinates (X = texture right, Y = texture up, Z = texture thickness), in pixels (1/16 block): in third person, Y and Z move the item diagonally up/down (Z more 'up/down', Y more 'left/right'), and X is forward/back from the body. To straighten the tilt, set rotate X = -55 (third person) / -25 (first person), then fine-tune the on-screen angle with rotate Z. All 0 = no adjustment
sre.custom_item.label.hold_rotate_x: Hold rotate X (front/back tilt; use to straighten)
sre.custom_item.hint.texture_mode: Buttons switch the rendering source; below only settings for the current source are shown. The model path can be filled under all four sources (under texture source it is an optional shell model). Switching does not clear values filled under other sources
sre.custom_item.hint.texture_path: A PNG path, e.g. mypack:textures/item/my_gun.png; when the animated texture first frame is left blank it also falls back to this
sre.custom_item.hint.inherit_texture: Enter an item id (e.g. noellesroles:c4): this item fully inherits that item's model and texture, looking identical
sre.custom_item.hint.animated_textures: Texture paths, looped in order (unlimited frames); each frame uses the same path format, e.g. mypack:textures/item/frame1.png
sre.custom_item.hint.animated_models: Model json paths in the resource pack, read in looped order; e.g. mypack:item/frame1 or mypack:models/item/frame1.json. Reload resources (F3+T) after changing
sre.custom_item.hint.model_path: Path to the model json in the resource pack, e.g. mypack:item/my_gun or mypack:models/item/my_gun.json; reload resources (F3+T) after changing for it to be baked
sre.custom_item.hint.model_shell: Under texture source, if a model path is filled, that model is used as the shell and the texture above is applied; left blank it uses the default model (flat quad, 1 pixel thick)
sre.custom_item.hint.model_texture: If filled, reskins the model: geometry uses the model above, texture uses this one (same path format as texture path); left blank it uses the model's built-in texture
sre.custom_item.hint.allow_left_click_at: Off by default: left-clicking a player while holding it deals no damage or knockback; turn on for melee items (special vanilla items are unaffected)
sre.custom_item.hint.consume_on_empty_fi: Whether to consume the item on an empty shot (charge completed but no player hit): yes = consumed on empty shot, no = not consumed on empty shot; hits still settle by 'Consume item'. Default yes.
sre.custom_item.hint.charge_anim_split: First-person = the hand animation you see on your screen, third-person = the arm pose others see; third-person can choose 'follow first-person' or any vanilla arm pose (adds crossbow aim / spyglass / toot horn over first-person); in JSON, blank means follow first-person
sre.custom_item.label.self_commands: Commands executed on the user after charge completes
sre.custom_item.hint.empty_fire_cooldown: Separate cooldown entered when charge completes but no player is hit (ticks, default 0 = no empty-shot cooldown). It is independent of the 'Cooldown after use' above and only takes effect when 'Affects other players' is on
sre.custom_item.hint.empty_fire_message: Text shown to the user via the actionbar above the inventory when charge completes but no player is hit
sre.custom_item.hint.affect_only_max_ran: Only affects players within the outermost block of the range; e.g. at range 5, affects players 4-5 blocks away; off affects the whole range
sre.custom_item.hint.distance_rules: When hitting a player beyond 'distance' blocks, run the command on the right on them (<player> = the hit player, <attacker> = the shooter)
sre.custom_item.label.hits_to_final: Which hit triggers the final effect
sre.custom_item.hint.hit_marker_ticks: If the final effect isn't triggered within this many ticks after a hit, the hit marker auto-clears and the count restarts from 0; the marker is stored on the hit player and separated per item, so different items don't stack
sre.custom_item.label.final_cooldown: Gun cooldown when final effect triggers
sre.custom_item.label.shoot_commands: Commands executed when the gun is right-click fired
sre.custom_item.label.hit_commands: Commands executed by players hit by the gun
sre.custom_item.label.final_hit_commands: Commands on the hit player when the final effect triggers
sre.custom_item.hint.lethal_on_ray_hit: When on, every player the ray hits dies instantly; for automatic guns the first shot kills the target, so hits are not accumulated and the final effect is not triggered
sre.custom_item.label.lethal_on_final: Only kills when final effect triggers
sre.custom_item.hint.lethal_on_final: When on, kills the hit player when the hit count reaches 'which hit triggers the final effect'; independent of the above; when both are on, ray-hit-kill takes priority
sre.custom_item.hint.lethal_death_reason: Death cause used on a kill; kill feed / coroner / insurance / cerebellum (mis-kill) penalty all read it; default revolver shot (starrailexpress:revolver_shot). If an unrecognized death cause is filled, the cerebellum penalty won't trigger

sre.custom_item.label.attacker_commands: Commands executed on left-click hit by attacker
